These unmodified generated headers are from Khronos OpenXR SDK release 1.1.53:

https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK/tree/release-1.1.53/include/openxr

They are distributed under Apache-2.0 OR MIT, as indicated by each header's SPDX notice.
The application uses function pointers from Meta Spatial SDK's existing OpenXR instance.
It does not create a second OpenXR instance or link a second loader.
